ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-12-28..2025-12-26) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-26..2026-06-26
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-26..2026-06-26

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-26 and 2026-03-27) — FY2025 DPS 1.12 + the quarters since (2026-03-27: 0.295, 2026-06-26: 0.295) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-28: 0.275, 2025-06-27: 0.275)

notes: annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2015-12-25 is filed as 1.23 (10-K filed 2016-02-16, 10-K filed 2017-02-21) and as 0.41 (10-K filed 2018-02-20, 10-K/A filed 2018-04-23) — restated for a share-basis change with no ratio fact filed — the diluted share count for the period ended 2015-12-25 was re-filed ×3.00 on 2018-02-20; read as 3-for-1 (the per-share values move ×3.0000, the share count ×3.0000); 0.41 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2016-12-30 is filed as 1.35 (10-K filed 2017-02-21) and as 0.45 (10-K filed 2018-02-20, 10-K/A filed 2018-04-23) — restated for a share-basis change with no ratio fact filed — the diluted share count for the period ended 2015-12-25 was re-filed ×3.00 on 2018-02-20; read as 3-for-1 (the per-share values move ×3.0000, the share count ×3.0000); 0.45 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

share-basis change with no ratio fact filed: the FY DPS for the period ended 2015-12-25 and the diluted share count for the period ended 2015-12-25 were both re-filed by the same factor (first on 2018-02-20) — read as a 3-for-1 split effective 2018-02-20; every per-share fact last filed before 2018-02-20 is restated by it

split adjustment (declared DPS): 28 facts for periods ending 2008-12-26..2015-12-25 were last filed before the 3-for-1 split effective 2018-02-20 (no ratio fact: the factor the filer re-filed its FY DPS and diluted share counts by) and are divided by the split ratio (filed, or evidenced by the re-filed values) to today's share basis

share_issuance: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2025-06-27: the year-to-date facts decrease (2024-12-28..2025-03-28 = 31,574,000 > 2024-12-28..2025-06-27 = 29,318,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -2.3M; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-26 and 2026-03-27) — FY2025 DPS 1.12 + the quarters since (2026-03-27: 0.295, 2026-06-26: 0.295) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-28: 0.275, 2025-06-27: 0.275)
